Can I get a refund on an annual plan?: Annual plans can be cancelled for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of approval.
Are monthly plans refundable?: Monthly plans are not refundable, but you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the billing period.
How much is the Team plan?: The Team plan costs $29 per agent per month when billed annually, or $35 per agent per month when billed monthly.
Do you offer phone support?: Phone support is available only on the Business plan, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time.
How long do you keep closed tickets?: Closed tickets are kept for 24 months on the Team plan and for 60 months on the Business plan.
